lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zr28Fe8Si8 (reduced formula Zr7Fe2Si2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 44 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies two main environments: one where Fe and Si each occupy tetrahedral coordination with four Zr neighbors, and another where Zr has 12 geometric neighbors (4 Fe, 4 Si, 4 Zr), with a close-packed-like local arrangement. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 44 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show corner-sharing between Fe and Si tetrahedra, and between like tetrahedra, while Zr 12-vertex polyhedra exhibit corner-, edge-, and face-sharing.
